papers.title: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: Proposes GrepMem, which keeps an agent's full history in an append-only plain-text log and recalls it on demand via regex search, avoiding lossy summarization and any embedding or retrieval index. Trained with RL on Qwen3.5-9B, it reports 95-97% accuracy on ContextBench versus at most 21% for lossy baselines, while staying on the accuracy-token-cost Pareto frontier across five tasks.

papers.title: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
papers.summary: A 100-page review of in-context learning for robots, organized around the interfaces between contextual evidence and execution: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill/agent-based execution. It compares their transfer assumptions and evaluation practices, and outlines an agenda toward compositional task acquisition and physical recursive self-improvement.
